caption:
OPERATING COSTS: CYPRUS ELECTRICITY IN CONTEXT.

Eurostat reports €24.29 per 100 kWh for Cyprus non-household consumers in H2 2025 versus an EU average of €18.37. The comparison covers annual consumption of 500 to 2,000 MWh, so it is not a small-business bill quote.

Which country should we compare next?
